description:
• About our brand and products:

Read2Speak creates offline language learning materials designed to help learners progress naturally and consistently.

Our products are digital ebooks and workbooks structured by level (A1–C2) that focus on real language exposure, reading practice, and practical learning systems that learners can use every day.

Thousands of students worldwide use our materials to build vocabulary, improve comprehension, and develop real language skills step by step.

• What makes us different:

Most language learning apps focus on gamification and short exercises that rarely lead to real progress.

Speak4Real takes a different approach.

Our materials are designed for deep language exposure through reading and structured practice, helping learners build real understanding of the language instead of memorizing isolated phrases.

Key differences:

• Structured learning from A1 to C2
• Reading-based immersion approach
• Practical exercises and workbooks
• Designed for consistent daily progress
• Used by learners around the world

• How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates earn a commission for every sale generated through their referral link or discount code.

Benefits of our affiliate program:

• Competitive commission rates
• High-converting digital products
• Global audience of language learners
• Ready-to-use content ideas and materials
• Long cookie duration for better attribution

The more you promote, the more you earn.

• How to promote us:

Affiliates can promote Speak4Real in many ways, including:

• Short videos on TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube
• Language learning tips and study routines
• Showing how they use the materials
• Reviews of the ebooks and learning system
• Sharing their personal language learning journey

Authentic and natural content performs best.

• Other information:

Once approved, affiliates receive:

• A personal referral link
• A unique discount code for their audience
• Content ideas and examples
• Access to promotional materials

Our goal is to build long-term partnerships with creators who genuinely want to help people learn languages.
